newsitem.title: USA: CBOT members vote to trade ag futures in contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT members vote to trade ag futures in contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade members voted Tuesday by a margin of 428 to 258 to change the trading unit of agricultural futures to contracts instead of bushels beginning January 2, 1998.
The CBOT said the new trading format would increase record-keeping efficiency by providing a simpler format for placing orders.
Soybean, corn, wheat and oats futures currently trade in bushels. The CBOT's board backed the change in June 1996.
